title: Webfollower w Libre3, Signal Missed
symptom: xDrip+ with Webfollower and Libre3 suddenly shows 'Signal Missed' after an update of LibreLinkUp, while Libre3 app and LibreLinkUp app work correctly.
cause: The API links used by xDrip for LibreLinkUp have changed.
fix: Update the API links to the correct ones, e.g., api-us.libreview.io, api-eu.libreview.io, etc. The solution is described in the discussion and a summary is available at https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Libre3_Follow.html.
evidence_quote: The api-links have changed. those should be correct: api-us.libreview.io api-eu.libreview.io api-fr.libreview.io api-au.libreview.io api-jp.libreview.io api-de.libreview.io api-ca.libreview.io
